title: I Signed up for 76 Birthday Freebies, Here are the Top 9...
description: For more content like this in podcast form visit https://www.curiosityness.com  My video on How to Unlock Every FREE BIRTHDAY OFFER Possible (Step By Step): https://youtu.be/dwteCtmXeMY   A month before my birthday, I signed up for nearly every birthday freebie and deal that I could find. In the end, I signed up for 76 different offers that applied to me and were in my area.  However, it quickly became apparent that there was just no way I was going to redeem all of these birthday offers.   Many of them required I spend money in order to get something free (like Red Lobster's free dessert but only when you buy two adult entrees. Seriously?)  Some of them I just didn't really care about at all (like a 15% off coupon to World Market).  And a lot of the offers weren't any better than a coupon you'd receive in the mail (like Jack in the Box's 2 free tacos with purchase) Even worse, a lot of companies didn't even send me the birthday offer they had promised.  The internet is full of large lists that contain every birthday freebie offer on earth, a simple Google search will find you one for your area.   So instead of another massive list, I want to share the 9 best birthday offers you should redeem. Plus, I'll include a list of the offers that are good, not great but good, along with some of the worst birthday offers that aren't worth your time.    The Top 9 Birthday Freebies and Offers:  Krispy Kreme: Free Doughnut and coffee (no purchase necessary)  Grimaldi's Pizza: Free 16” pizza (no purchase necessary)  Fuddruckers: Free 1/3lb burger (no purchase necessary)  Black Angus Steak House: Free Entree with purchase of another entree of equal or greater value up to $20.99 (plus they'll probably give you a free dessert at the restaurant)  Local Recreational Activities: There are some great deals on local recreational activities if you look for them in your area. For my birthday I golfed for free at a course that normally costs $75+ for a tee time.   Starbucks: A free handcrafted beverage or food item  Habit Burger: Free Charburger (no purchase necessary)  Denny's: Free Build your own Grand Slam (only on the day of your birthday)  Dickies Barbecue: Classic Sandwich (no purchase necessary)    Good, Not Great but Good, Birthday Freebies and Offers: These are good if you were planning on going there anyway or happen to be close, but I wouldn't make a special trip to most of these places.  Dunkin' Doughnuts: Free Beverage (no purchase necessary)  Hooters: 10 free boneless wings with drink purchase   Sbarro: Free Slice of Pizza (no purchase necessary)  Einstein Bros Bagels: Free egg sandwich with any purchase  Baja Fresh: Free burrito with large drink purchase  Home Town Buffet: Buy one get one free buffet  El Pollo Loco: $5 gift card when you spend $1.99  Rubios: Free entree with purchase of another entree  Wingstop: Free large fries (no purchase necessary)  Nothing Bundt Cakes: Free Bundtlet (no purchase necessary)  Steak 'n Shake: Free Shake with $1 or more purchase  Tony Roma's: Free Entrée with the purchase of a second entrée  Arby's: Free Small Shake and Small Fries with purchase of any sandwich  Corner Bakery Cafe: Free Sweet (no purchase necessary)  Golden Corral: Free Buffet with buffet purchase  Veggie Grill: $5 off order  RedBox: Free 1-night disc rental  Del Taco: Free regular size shake (no purchase necessary)  Peet's Coffee: Free Beverage (no purchase necessary)  Pink Berry: Free yogurt (no purchase necessary)  A&W: Free Root Beer float (no purchase necessary)  Ihop: Free stack of pancakes (no purchase necessary)    The Bad Birthday Offers:  Most of these offers are just for a free dessert at a sit down restaurant. A lot of restaurants will give you a free dessert on your birthday without having to sign up for an email list.  Red Lobster: Free dessert with 2 entrees  World Market: 15% off coupon  Lazy Dog: Free dessert or starter  Islands: Free dessert  Johnny Rockets: Free burger with purchase of an entree and a drink or shake  Mimis: Free muffin sundae   Macaroni Grill: Free dessert  Coco's: Free slice of pie  Jack in the Box: 2 free tacos with purchase  Marie Callenders: Free Marie's Magnificent Six or free slice of pie with entree purchase   I hope this list makes your birthday a little more exciting, I found it fun to continue getting these small birthday freebies. Plus, with the exception of Denny's, most of these offers are valid for a few weeks before and after your birthday so you can celebrate all month long!  Enjoy and Happy Birthday!
